title: TopologyOverlaySignalAvailability
description: Scoped availability card for a catalog-backed signal that may render as topology overlay effects. This is planner-facing metadata, not source execution detail.

status.description: Whether this overlay signal can currently be rendered for the scoped topology artifact.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids that define this overlay signal. Single-signal cards normally contain one id; compound signals can contain multiple ids.

displayName.description: Short display label for prompt context and diagnostics.

description.description: Brief explanation of what this signal represents in the scoped artifact.

surface.description: Runtime surface where this signal can be applied.

targetKinds.description: Topology target kinds that can receive this signal in the current artifact.

supportedEffects.description: Visual effects that topology-service can compile for this signal and target kind.

deliveryModes.description: Coarse delivery support exposed to agent-core. Detailed polling, SSE, source, and freshness policy remain topology-service runtime details.
